# Jesus Enters Jerusalem Humbly Story Path

**Lesson:** K4-L20 - Jesus Enters Jerusalem Humbly

**Read:** Matthew 21:1-11

## Observe
- Record two direct observations from the passage.
- Identify relevant context and genre.

## Reason
- Test this big idea: Jesus entered as the promised King without copying worldly power.
- Label what is explicit text, synthesis/inference, framework position, or prudential application.

## Respond
- Name one faithful response that does not claim more than the evidence supports.

## Guardrail
- Present Jesus’ humble entry as part of the Gospel narrative, not as a simplistic endorsement of any modern political movement.
purpose: Support the Jesus Enters Jerusalem Humbly lesson with an evidence-based story path.
